watch_list.summary: Lauren’s AI Engineer talk “All Code Is Slop (Except Mine)” is on YouTube, covering how the Grok Bot team ships quickly without compromising quality (https://youtu.be/O_zcc6Xl12g).
Asking agents for the smallest or quickest change can spread bandaid patterns; she says agents change the calculus, so sometimes you should have them fix the root cause even if it’s more invasive.
Her tip for following through: don’t ask if you should do the thing — do it, then come back with a demo or something tangible.

items.title: When Your Customer Is a Superintelligent Agent: How Coinbase uses Grok Bot
items.summary: In this ~50-minute workshop, Coinbase’s Lincoln Murr and SpaceXSI’s Jon Farland explain agentic finance, then demo Grok Bot workflows that watch news, rebalance, and trade through the Coinbase connector with set guardrails.

items.title: How I Get Perfect AI Realism in Every Shot (3 Steps)
items.summary: A three-step workflow for a consistent 4K AI commercial: lock product and character assets, use a Claude skill to turn a script into Seedance prompts and a shotlist, then iterate bathroom, kitchen, and street scenes into one polished ad.

items.title: Seedance 2.5 4K Just Made AI Creatures Look Ultra Realistic! (Free Claude Skill)
items.summary: Adil shows a movie-creature-shop pipeline in Claude with Higgsfield MCP—clay sculpt, face reference, real materials, and a flash-photo trick—then a free skill that builds and animates a realistic creature in Seedance 2.5 4K.

items.title: Why Shoot 3 Camera Angles When AI Can Make Them From One Clip?
items.summary: A short demo of Higgsfield generating extra camera angles, moves, and even a new location from a single one-camera clip, with the original footage kept on screen to compare.

items.title: 專家說2027年最賺錢的AI生意不是寫程式，而是當網紅！注意力經濟的時代來臨了嗎？｜Kelly Tsai
items.summary: Kelly unpacks the claim that by 2027 the most profitable AI business may be creating attention as an influencer, not writing code, and asks whether the attention economy has arrived.

items.title: 一支影片搞懂 AI 的底層邏輯，LLM 到底是什麼？
items.summary: Gary condenses Andrej Karpathy’s intro-to-LLMs talk: pretraining and hallucinations, SFT and RLHF, the black-box problem, plus Karpathy’s earlier predictions and security warnings.
